title: An individual is defined by the continuity of its experience

statements.text: An individual is defined by the continuity of its experience. In a thought experiment where the quantum state of a person is teleported onto isomorphic matter elsewhere, the result is the same individual, with the same thoughts and memories.

sources.quote: It is reasonable to say that an individual is defined by the continuity of its experience.
The resulting individual would be the same as the original one, including his thoughts and memory.
